identity_semantics: SHA-256 of canonical node/link structure with static length, diameter, and roughness serialized at 9 significant decimal digits; mutable demand and tank state are excluded.
decision: Numerical canonicalization was selected because governed golden-reference has historical in-memory and EPANET .inp construction paths; it preserves one product-facing canonical identity without duplicating an allow-list.
regression_checks: EPANET write/parse round trip preserves the canonical golden identity.
Demand and tank state do not alter structural identity.
A meaningful static roughness change alters structural identity.
Governed family lookup is hash-only; an uploaded display name cannot confer applicability.
